interest: a reusable quiz tool that saves marking time and shows the department innovates
expectation: Expects the MVP demo in week 7 and a pilot with 50 students in week 14 within the 200 USD cash cap.

interest: a well-run project that delivers the MVP on time and teaches project management
expectation: Expects the sponsor to sign the charter in week 1, decide at the week-7 and week-13 gates, and answer change requests in writing within 5 working days.

interest: a working real-time core with a clear scope they can build in 8 h per week
expectation: Expect a frozen Must scope after the week-3 baseline and a tagged demo at the end of each build phase.

interest: a usable, accessible and responsive interface they can be proud of
expectation: Expects agreed screens and WCAG AA and browser targets by week 3 so the interface can be built without rework.

interest: a reliable CI pipeline, a deployable build and a load test that passes
expectation: Expects a running CI with coverage reporting by week 3 and the VPS and Caddy access by week 4.

interest: a quick and fun way to join a quiz and see their score and the leaderboard
expectation: Expect to join the week-14 pilot session with a 6-character code and see instant feedback without errors.

interest: less marking time and live feedback on how well students understand a topic
expectation: Expect a short user guide and a working quiz authoring and live session flow shown at the week-7 MVP demo.

interest: no surprises at go-live; a system that is easy to restart, monitor and back up
expectation: Expects a runbook, the production docker-compose file and a backup job handed over at the week-13 readiness gate.

role: Controls the campus proxy and firewall
interest: stable network traffic and no unapproved ports or protocols on campus
expectation: Expects a note on the WebSocket and SockJS traffic by week 8 and a test session before the pilot so it is allowed through the proxy.

interest: a project that meets the capstone rules and learning outcomes
expectation: Expects the MVP demo in week 7 and the final demo and documentation in week 14 to count toward the course.

interest: student names and results stored on campus under a retention rule
expectation: Expects a one-page data description before the pilot and can block the pilot if it is missing.

interest: a proven tool that other departments could adopt without extra cost
expectation: Expects a short pilot result report after week 14 showing usage, problems and costs.
